sections.overall: The router is healthy overall, with only minor issues: a few failed local logins, a short WAN blip around 09:38 UTC that recovered by 09:43, and brief Wi-Fi drops on the Nest Mini and iPhone. Confirm that the failed and then successful logins from 192.168.69.142 and 192.168.69.56 on Nov 15 were yours, and change the router admin password if they were not.
sections.security: The router web UI recorded 8 failed logins and 2 captcha errors from LAN host 192.168.69.142 between 09:11 and 09:36 on Nov 15, followed by a successful login from that host at 09:38. The ASUS Router app also failed to log in 3 times from 192.168.69.56 (Nov 15, 08:37–21:47), and that host later logged in successfully. Both look like a local user mistyping credentials, but confirm these were you. There were no outbound malware blocks, all 292 DNS filter health checks were OK, and the dropped inbound traffic looks like normal background scanning.
sections.system: The router reported a brief WAN problem at about 09:38 UTC on Nov 15 (2 checks with WAN down, 4 remedy actions, recovered by 09:43), plus an unexplained "anomaly" event at 22:05, though the LAN-side watchdog measured no outages. Everything else looks healthy: load, memory, temperatures, ping, jitter, packet loss and speeds are all normal and in line with the 7-day baseline.
sections.wifi: The Speaker 1 (02:00:5E:00:00:04) failed a group key handshake and was deauthenticated twice around 03:45, and the iPhone (02:00:5E:00:00:2A) was briefly disconnected three times for weak signal around 19:03. Otherwise there are no new devices and the client count looks normal.
